# Gwennol's Fish Cake

*Gwennol's flaked fish and potato, fried golden at the back of her stall. Restores 500 HP and 200 MP.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Type | Consumable |
| Effect | Restores 500 HP and 200 MP |
| Sells for | 200 mesos |

## How to get

- Dropped by [Pale Sawbill](../monsters/pale_sawbill.md) (2%)
- Dropped by [Sawbill](../monsters/sawbill.md) (2%)
- Dropped by [Sawbill Fry](../monsters/sawbill_fry.md) (2%)
- Dropped by [Spitting Sawbill](../monsters/spitting_sawbill.md) (2%)
- Sold at [Gwennol's Fish Stall](../shops/bain_fish.md) for 400 mesos
